The '''Czerka Corporate Labs''' was a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] used by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] on [[CZ-198]],<ref name="Flashpoint" /> a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|CZ-198}}</ref> that served as a testing ground and laboratory for the Czerka Corporation during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Titans of Industry">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/titans_of_industry|text=TITANS OF INDUSTRY}}</ref>

==History==
In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref> Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]] had the facility completely sealed off following the [[seizure of CZ-198]]. A strike team was tasked with infiltrating the facility and confront Blys, but their unauthorized entry did not go unnoticed. The team battled Czerka forces as they advanced to the [[Atrium (CZ-198)|Atrium]]. Upon reaching the flooded atrium, the team encountered the eradicator droid, [[CZ-8X Eradicator Droid|CZ-8X]], blocking their path. After defeating the eradicator droid, the team moved deeper into the facility and faced Blys's dangerous experiments. When the team entered [[Czerka Laboratories|Blys's lab]], they heard him condemning them before he activated the [[Vigilant]] security system and attacked. As the team approached the command console, a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the Vigilant appeared, threatening their demise.<ref name="Flashpoint" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Czerka Corporate Labs appears in the "Czerka Corporate Labs" flashpoint as part of the Game Update 2.3 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="Titans of Industry" />
